subject: Engineering decisions
title: leetcode-backend black-box suite (rust-services plan, phase 1)
question: What was measured for leetcode-backend black-box suite (rust-services plan, phase 1)?
method: Transcribed from the cited historical record. Units and precision follow the source.
finding: Reported observations and context: - Tier run: black-box integration through a real socket, against the production bundle (`node dist/bundle/index.mjs`): 4 files, 69 tests in about 10 s with the bundle build, all green. The service runs as a child process with a mock leetcode.com and a mock capture tool beside it; `LEETCODE_BACKEND_CMD` names another implementation, so the same suite runs unchanged on the Rust binary later (`pnpm --filter @app/leetcode-backend run test:blackbox`).

rows: - Tier run: black-box integration through a real socket, against the production bundle (`node dist/bundle/index.mjs`): 4 files, 69 tests in about 10 s with the bundle build, all green. The service runs as a child process with a mock leetcode.com and a mock capture tool beside it; `LEETCODE_BACKEND_CMD` names another implementation, so the same suite runs unchanged on the Rust binary later (`pnpm --filter @app/leetcode-backend run test:blackbox`).

- The suite pins the HTTP surface (health, CORS preflight, bearer and admin-secret checks with wrong-length and wrong-scheme cases, 404s including the 401 the admin router gives unknown paths under `/api/leetcode`, the 1 MB body limit, malformed JSON, the 120 per minute limit with `Retry-After`), sessions and the capture registry, the four LeetCode relays with the exact outbound requests (headers, cookies, bodies), the no-session path with the fire-and-forget capture trigger (and a negative probe that proves the request arrived), the hourly re-verification, and the local executor (Python and JavaScript, compare modes, per-case and compile errors, the 5 s timeout, unsupported languages, format).
